description: Looks at a WordPress address and says whether WebinarIgnition runs there and in what state: not installed, installed but too old, or ready. Take it before connecting, for example when a host says "Can my site even do this?" It needs the address and reads it over a secure connection, and nothing on the site is changed. It is also the quick check after a host moved their site to a new address, to see whether the plugin came along. The answer names one of the three states, nothing more. Words hosts use: check WordPress, installed, too old, ready

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

url.description: The WordPress address (seite). With was=handoff: the host's WordPress address to point the handover link at.

name: wi_check_wordpress
title: Check a WordPress address
